focus.title: 美商务部拟扩出口管制清单，涉先进半导体与AI芯片设备
focus.summary: 据多方消息，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）计划于本月晚些时候发布新规，进一步扩大对华出口管制范围，新增若干类先进半导体制造设备及用于AI训练的高性能芯片相关物项，并拟将部分中国实体列入实体清单。此举将影响中国AI芯片产业链的供应稳定性，企业需提前评估供应链风险，并考虑替代采购方案及合规审查。
focus.source: 来源：综合路透社、美国联邦公报预告 · 2026.09.08
focus.title_en: U.S. Commerce Dept. to Expand Export Controls on Advanced Semiconductors and AI Chip Equipment
focus.summary_en: According to multiple reports, the U.S. Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) plans to issue new rules later this month to further expand export controls on China, adding certain advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment and high-performance chips for AI training, and propose adding some Chinese entities to the Entity List. This will impact the supply chain stability of China's AI chip industry. Companies should assess supply chain risks in advance and consider alternative procurement and compliance reviews.
focus.source_en: Source: Based on Reuters and Federal Register notices · 2026.09.08

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决获中国法院承认，重申仲裁条款独立性
case.summary: 近期，某中国法院依据《纽约公约》承认并执行了新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）作出的一项裁决。该案中，一方当事人主张主合同无效故仲裁条款无效，法院明确仲裁条款独立于主合同，主合同效力争议不影响仲裁协议效力，且仲裁程序符合当事人约定及仲裁地法律。此案为中国企业参与国际仲裁提供了积极信号，强调在起草合同时应重视仲裁条款的明确性与独立性。
case.source: 来源：中国裁判文书网相关案例 · 2026.08
case.title_en: Chinese Court Recognizes SIAC Award, Reaffirming Separability of Arbitration Clause
case.summary_en: Recently, a Chinese court recognized and enforced an award rendered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) under the New York Convention. In this case, one party argued that the arbitration clause was invalid because the main contract was void. The court clarified that the arbitration clause is independent of the main contract, and disputes over the validity of the main contract do not affect the validity of the arbitration agreement. The arbitral procedure complied with the parties' agreement and the law of the seat. This case provides a positive signal for Chinese enterprises in international arbitration, emphasizing the importance of clear and independent arbitration clauses in contracts.
case.source_en: Source: China Judgments Online related case · 2026.08

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境纠纷调解合作新规出台，推动商事调解互认
policy.summary: 为深化粤港澳大湾区法治协同，广东省司法厅联合香港律政司、澳门法务局于近日发布《粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷调解合作指引》，明确三地调解机构可相互聘任调解员，并推动调解协议互认与执行衔接。该指引鼓励企业优先通过调解解决跨境争议，降低诉讼成本。相关配套细则将于年内落地，为大湾区企业提供更高效的争议解决渠道。
policy.source: 来源：广东省司法厅官网 · 2026.09.02
policy.title_en: New Guidelines for Cross-border Mediation Cooperation in the Greater Bay Area Promote Mutual Recognition
policy.summary_en: To deepen legal collaboration in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), the Department of Justice of Guangdong Province, together with the Department of Justice of Hong Kong and the Legal Affairs Bureau of Macao, recently issued the 'Guidelines for Cooperation on Cross-border Commercial Mediation in the GBA', which allow mediation institutions in the three regions to mutually appoint mediators and promote mutual recognition and enforcement of mediation agreements. The guidelines encourage enterprises to use mediation first to resolve cross-border disputes, reducing litigation costs. Detailed implementation rules will be introduced within the year, providing more efficient dispute resolution channels for GBA enterprises.
policy.source_en: Source: Official website of Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice · 2026.09.02

analysis.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期实务要点与应对建议
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）已于2025年进入正式实施阶段，中国出口企业需关注2026年过渡期后的申报义务。建议企业：一、梳理出口产品是否落入CBAM覆盖范围（如钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力、氢），并建立碳排放数据监测体系；二、提前核算产品隐含排放，必要时引入第三方核证；三、关注欧盟免费配额逐步取消的节奏，评估中长期成本影响。同时，应利用过渡期与欧盟进口商协商数据共享与合同条款，避免因数据缺失导致高额碳税。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队研究 · 2026.09.08
analysis.title_en: Practical Points and Recommendations for EU CBAM Transition Period
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) entered its operational phase in 2025, and Chinese exporters need to pay attention to reporting obligations after the transition period in 2026. Recommendations: First, identify whether exported products fall within CBAM coverage (e.g., steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, electricity, hydrogen) and establish a carbon emission data monitoring system. Second, calculate embedded emissions in advance, and consider third-party verification if necessary. Third, monitor the gradual phase-out of free allowances and assess medium- and long-term cost impacts. Also, use the transition period to negotiate data sharing and contract terms with EU importers to avoid high carbon costs due to missing data.
